lines.zh: 我一步一晃，扇子没停过。
lines.en: I sway as I walk, fan never still.

lines.zh: 泥沼的水没过我的脚踝。
lines.en: Mire water reaches my ankles.
Algae grows on my shell.
I walk over rotten mud.
Water seeps into every footprint.
A wave of my fan clears the mist.

lines.zh: 这个群系里没有人该站着。
lines.en: No one should stand in this mire.
I patrol the waterline.
Water sloshes in my head's dish.
I kick something out of the mud.
I stand, fanning gently.
The dish on my head is nearly full.
Fog here never lifts.
I listen to the marsh gas.

lines.zh: 我是这片泥沼的统治者。
lines.en: I rule this mire.
Insects walk my shell.

lines.zh: 我用扇子赶走沼面的飞虫。
lines.en: I fan the midges off the swamp surface.

lines.zh: 我把扇子换到另一只手。
lines.en: I switch the fan to my other hand.

lines.zh: 泥沼里没有干净的东西。
lines.en: Nothing clean in this mire.
You have stepped into my mire.

lines.zh: 我的扇子不是用来纳凉的。
lines.en: This fan is not for cooling.

lines.zh: 你的靴子已经开始往下陷。
lines.en: Your boots have already begun to sink.
I tilt my head; water spills out.
Everyone here dies.
My beak can snap bone.
You are wet to the knee.
Do not hope to outrun this fog.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，但你一定会湿透。
lines.en: I am slow, but you will be soaked.
Mud seeps through the crack into my shell.
I retreat into the mud.
I do not cry out. I laugh low.
The mire shields me.

lines.zh: 头盘里的水洒了，我扶正它。
lines.en: The water in my basin spills; I set it right.
One rib of my fan is bent.

lines.zh: 我这把扇子，扇的是泥水。
lines.en: This fan of mine flings muddy water.
But you are still in my mud.

lines.zh: 我的扇骨断了一根，照样扇。
lines.en: One rib of my fan is broken; I still fan.
Nothing good comes from the mire.
You think an offering buys your life?
I take it, then I strike.
Put it in the mud.
I reach out slowly.

lines.zh: 扇子借你扇两下，别靠太近。
lines.en: You may wave my fan twice — just don't get close.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没有白吃的黄瓜。
lines.en: No free cucumbers in this mire.

lines.zh: 想讨好我？先学会在水里呼吸。
lines.en: Want to please me? First learn to breathe underwater.
You hit a wet shell.

lines.zh: 我的扇子一挡，泥水四溅。
lines.en: My fan comes up and mud water sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞在你胸口，很闷。
lines.en: My shell thuds into your chest.
Water spills from my dish.
You did not keep your footing.
This mud eats people.

lines.zh: 你撞翻了我头上的水盘。
lines.en: You knocked over the water basin on my head.

lines.zh: 撞到本大爷的壳，赔得起吗？
lines.en: Bumped into my shell — can you afford the damage?
Only I remain in this mire.
That happens in deep water.
You smell of the mire.
I shake my head; water spills again.

lines.zh: 我的头盘一歪，水泼在你脚边。
lines.en: My basin tips and water splashes at your feet.
My shell is old.
I keep fanning.
I turn away.

lines.zh: 我合上扇子，往深水那边去。
lines.en: I close my fan and head for the deep water.
This counts as a thing?
Too clean. I dislike it.
I drop it back in the mud.
This could sharpen my beak.
I tuck it in a shell seam.

lines.zh: 地上全是一样烂的东西。
lines.en: The ground is all rot alike.
I crush it.

lines.zh: 我这把扇子，是沼泽的权柄。
lines.en: This fan is the swamp's authority.
You stand. I come.
My fog has closed on you.
The fan has turned to you.
No one walks out of here.
I want your bones.
The mud will hold you.
My beak is open.
Do you hear the marsh gas?
The dish is full.

lines.zh: 你成了我泥沼的一部分。
lines.en: You become part of my mire.

lines.zh: 我把扇子合拢，指向你的膝。
lines.en: I snap my fan shut and point it at your knee.
You cannot retreat now.
The fan-bearing Kappa has waited long.

lines.zh: 泥浆正顺着我的壳往下淌。
lines.en: Mud runs down the length of my shell.
I shift toward you an inch at a time.
My fan stirs up muddy mist.
You are on soft ground.
My feet are sure in mud.
One step back from you, two from me.
My shell turns your blade.
The fog thickens.

lines.zh: 我半身没在水里，一步步挪。
lines.en: Half sunk in the water, I shuffle closer.
You are covered in mud.
Water drips from my dish.

lines.zh: 你只剩下这一小块干地。
lines.en: You have only this patch of dry ground.

lines.zh: 我不急，泥沼有的是时间。
lines.en: I am patient. The mire has time.
You look for a path. Every path is water.
My beak is less than an arm away.
One more step and you sink.
I fling mud at your face.
That is my step.
You drown, or you are bitten.

lines.zh: 我扇起的雾遮住了你的火把。
lines.en: The mist I fan up hides your torch.
My beak closes on your shoulder.
The fan's ribs rake your face.
That came with bog water.
Your armor grows heavy in the mud.
The fan folds; now it's real.
I hook your leg and drop you.

lines.zh: 泥和水一起灌进你的领口。
lines.en: Mud and water pour down your collar.
The fan closes, tightening slowly.
You can hear me chewing.

lines.zh: 这一下不深，下一口会深。
lines.en: That cut was shallow. The next bite will not be.
The fan caught you off balance.
I let go, and you sink again.
The ribs of my fan slap across your knuckles.
You are breathing mud water.
This is your grave.
One fan stroke, and the fog thickens.

lines.zh: 我按住你的头往泥里压。
lines.en: I press your head down into the mud.
Sink.
My shell shows in the fog first.

lines.zh: 这片泥沼已经很久没人来了。
lines.en: No one has come to this mire in a long while.

lines.zh: 扇子一收，我从水里站起来。
lines.en: The fan folds, and I rise from the water.
Moss slides off my back.
I own this mire.

lines.zh: 水从我头盘边缘溢出来。
lines.en: Water overflows my dish.
I fan once; the fog parts and closes.
Bubbles rise at my feet.

lines.zh: 沼雾里，我的扇子先露出来。
lines.en: In the swamp mist, my fan shows first.
You have come too deep.
This water is mine.
I open the fan.

lines.zh: 火把泥里的水烤得直响。
lines.en: Fire hisses on the wet mire.
I fall from the bank into muck.
Even I can drown. It is no joke.
The bog gas bursts and throws me.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我的壳缝里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell seam.
That light heats my dish.

lines.zh: 泥沼也有没东西的时候。
lines.en: Even the mire has lean times.
Lightning strikes my water dish.
